summary: AGDER VITENSKAPSAKADEMI (org. no. 890 666 922) is an association (FLI) based in Kristiansand, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-07-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Rolf Tomas Nossum; board chair: May-Brith Ohman Nielsen.
